title: 自动化科学机器学习：前沿智能体能否在真实环境中攀登科学高峰？
summary: 提出 Agent4Sci 长周期测试平台，覆盖 11 个领域 20 个科学 ML 基准，评估前沿编码智能体超越已发表最优模型的能力。结果显示 Claude Opus 平均相对提升 10.4%，但主要来自 ML 工程技巧而非研究洞察；加入研究构思等轻量技能后提升至 20.1%。
summary_en: Introduces Agent4Sci, a long-horizon testbed spanning 20 scientific ML benchmarks across 11 domains to measure how far frontier coding agents can improve on published best models. Claude Opus achieves 10.4% mean relative improvement, driven mostly by ML-engineering tricks rather than research insight; lightweight research-ideation skills raise it to 20.1%.
